title: A pipeline with channels
description:
Pass work between a producer and several consumers with `System.Threading.Channels`.

```
worker 1 squared 1 -> 1
worker 2 squared 2 -> 4
...
sum of squares 1..20 = 2870
```
hints: `await channel.Writer.WriteAsync(n);` waits when the channel is full, then `channel.Writer.Complete();` ends the consumers' loops (lesson 7.06).
`Task.Run(async () => { await foreach (...) { ... } })` starts one consumer; make three in a loop.
requirements: A bounded channel of capacity 5; the producer writes 1 to 20 and then completes the writer.
Three consumers read with `await foreach (var n in reader.ReadAllAsync())` and add their results to a shared total with `Interlocked.Add`.
Wait for all consumers with `Task.WhenAll`; the output order can change between runs.
stretch: Add a second stage: the squares go into another channel, where one consumer prints them in order.
